title: The music theory of V A P O R W A V E
summary: Adam Neely analyzes vaporwave through music theory, timbre and nostalgia, and includes a parody track made for the video. He also touches on the phenomenology of music.
why: Cited as a short, fun introduction to the phenomenology of music and as an explanation and critique of vaporwave.

quote.text: The following fun, short talk does a great job of introducing the concept of through its analysis of "vaporwave.
